requirements.label: Minor requirements (from LSA)
requirements.hint: Requirements Minimum Credits: 15 A minimum of 5 courses and 15 credits are required, distributed as followsSurvey Requirement: Students must take one of the following four courses:HISTORY 237: Global Environmental HistoryHISTORY 238: Zoom: A History of EverythingHISTORY 239: The World Before 1492HISTORY 240: The World Since 1492Four additional courses (a minimum of 3 credits each for at least 12 credits) are also required, with at least two of the four at the 300-level or above. These courses must be chosen from the Global History Minor Approved Course List. Please review the History Department’s Course List page to view a list of current and previously offered courses. Use the Minor dropdown filter to search specifically for courses approved for the Global History minor. Constraints AP credit: AP credits may not be used to satisfy requirements of the minor.
